race.title: Come Racing At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: An open-looking finale that may go the way of handicap debutant LYRICAL CHOICE . The dangers are headed by Moab and Beau Quali , the latter particularly interesting if supported. LYRICAL CHOICE (IRE) MOAB (IRE) BEAU QUALI (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Emerald Breeze (11/4), Moab (10/3), Lyrical Choice (6/1), Lewisham Grove (6/1), Fidendum (10/1), Vivid Pink (10/1), Faded Fantasy (12/1), Kentucky River (16/1), Dirty Den (20/1), Devon Skies (20/1), Beau Quali (33/1)
